usageNotes: Use this endpoint to preview which backups would be kept or removed if a prune operation were run against a storage target — without actually deleting anything. Supply the same retention policy (via `prune-backups`) that you plan to pass to the actual DELETE prune call to ensure the preview matches the real outcome. Note that the result is a snapshot in time; backups added or removed between this preview and the subsequent prune call may produce different results.

examples.summary: Preview prune results for VM 101 on local backup storage, keeping the last 3 backups and 1 per week

tips: Backups marked 'protected' or with non-standard naming are never removed — they will appear in the response with mark='protected' or mark='renamed' regardless of the retention policy.
If you omit `prune-backups`, the preview uses the retention policy already configured on the storage itself, which is the most common use case when validating existing policy.
Filter by `type` (qemu or lxc) to scope the preview to one guest type when a storage holds mixed backup sets.
The caller needs either Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on /storage/{storage} — API tokens are supported.
